description:
Somos un equipo de estudiantes interesados en la ciencia, la tecnología y la exploración espacial. Nos apasiona aprender sobre el universo, descubrir nuevas ideas y participar en proyectos innovadores relacionados con la NASA.

Somos personas creativas, responsables, curiosas y comprometidas con el trabajo en equipo. Queremos compartir nuestros conocimientos, desarrollar nuevas habilidades y trabajar juntos para alcanzar nuestras metas.

details:
Our project consists of an educational and interactive website that allows children to learn about NASA's space equipment and missions on the Moon and Mars. First, we conducted research on different devices and machines sent into space, including their characteristics, functions, missions, and discoveries. Then, we organized all this information on a website so that users can explore the content in a simple and attractive way.

As a complement, we developed an educational game containing questions related to our research. It works by allowing children to answer questions and test the knowledge they have gained from reading the information. This way, they can reinforce what they have learned while having fun.

Some of its benefits include strengthening memory, reasoning, comprehension, and spatial skills. The impact we hope to achieve is to awaken children's curiosity about science, technology, and space exploration, motivating them to learn in a different way.

To develop this project, we used digital tools to research, design, and build the website and interactive game. Its creativity comes from combining research with educational activities, turning scientific information into an entertaining experience. Our team also considered the users' age, ease of navigation, content comprehension, and the importance of presenting information in a visual and dynamic way.
